def pareto():
    """精度-延迟权衡：延迟越大精度越高，前沿是「同延迟下精度最高」的包络。"""
    with plt.rc_context(RC):
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.4, 3.0))
        rng = np.random.default_rng(2)
        xs = np.linspace(40, 180, 26)
        # 边际收益递减：开方曲线 + 噪声
        ys = 62 + 16 * np.sqrt((xs - 30) / 150) + rng.normal(0, 0.6, len(xs))
        ax.scatter(xs, ys, s=18, c="#B0B7C3", label="candidates", zorder=2)

        # 帕累托前沿：延迟递增时，精度严格创新高的点
        order = np.argsort(xs)
        keep, best = [], -1e9
        for i in order:
            if ys[i] > best:
                best = ys[i]
                keep.append(i)
        ax.plot(xs[keep], ys[keep], "-", color="#C97B8B", lw=1.4, label="Pareto front", zorder=3)
        ax.scatter(xs[keep], ys[keep], s=34, c="#C97B8B",
                   edgecolors="white", linewidths=0.6, zorder=4)
        ax.annotate("ours", xy=(xs[keep[-1]], ys[keep[-1]]),
                    xytext=(-26, -14), textcoords="offset points",
                    fontsize=8, color="#8C3B4A",
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", lw=0.6, color="#8C3B4A"))
        ax.set_xlabel("Latency (ms)"); ax.set_ylabel("Top-1 (%)")
        ax.legend(frameon=False, loc="lower right")
        ax.set_title("Accuracy vs. latency")
        return _save(fig, "fig-qua-pareto")

def super_resolution():

        for ax, (im, t) in zip(axes, [(lr, "Low-res input"), (blur, "Baseline"),

def depth_maps():
    """深度图 / 点云渲染对比。"""
    with plt.rc_context(RC):
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(6.0, 2.2))
        h, w = 60, 80
        yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w]
        depth = 1.0 / (1 + np.exp(-(yy - h / 2) / 8.0)) + 0.15 * np.sin(xx / 6.0)
        for ax, (d, t, cm) in zip(axes, [(depth, "GT depth", "viridis"),
                                         (depth + 0.05 * np.random.default_rng(1).normal(size=depth.shape),
                                          "Baseline", "viridis"),
                                         (depth, "Ours (points)", "magma")]):
            im = ax.imshow(d, cmap=cm)
            ax.set_title(t); ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.grid(False)
        fig.colorbar(im, ax=axes, fraction=0.02, pad=0.02, label="depth (m)")
        return _save(fig, "fig-qual-depth")
